Star Wars Customizable Card Game -
   ESB Hoth 2-Player Edition
Decipher- 1996

Note:  Decipher Cards offered excellent checklists and spoiler lists at their  website, now 
maintained at the SWCCG website.  However, I have also been asked questions about 
which and how many cards were included in the "introductory two-player" card boxes for 
Premiere and Hoth (Empire Strikes Back), and that information could not be gleaned from 
Decipher's posted checklists. Except for the "sort by rarity" section, I separate the "Light 
Side" and "Dark Side" cards, which have different back designs, and note in the titles where 
the same-named cards are found in both "decks."

The 2-player starter decks contained a selection of cards from the Premiere, A New Hope, 
and Hoth expansions, plus a handful of cards exclusive to this release. The expansions where 
the cards also appear are shown. All cards here show a 1996 copyright date.

For character and vehicle attributes, I use these abbreviations: Stats: 1st space is Power,
2nd space is Ability, 3rd space is Force Affinity (A=attuned, S=sensitive, J=Jedi, M=Jedi
Master). For vehicles and droids, 2nd space is Armor or Maneuver and 3rd space is speed
(H=hyperspeed, L=landspeed). Cost: 1st space is Deploy Cost, 2nd space is Forfeit Value.
